objective: Preallocate deferred subquery outer-column extraction buffers from SELECT AST shape.

tasks.title: Preallocate outer column extraction buffers
tasks.result: Deferred subquery outer-column extraction now preallocates local relation and referenced-column sets from the SELECT AST.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The local relation capacity uses FROM plus JOIN relation count with room for table aliases.
The referenced column capacity uses selection, having, and projection expression counts.
